title: Tool of the Day · OpusClip — you don't need an editor

scenes.line: You don't need an editor to post clips.
scenes.cue: Flat and certain. The claim, not a tease. Hit 'editor'.

scenes.line: The free plan gives you sixty minutes a month.
scenes.cue: The number is already on screen counting. Say it like a fact you checked.

scenes.line: Feed it any podcast, talk or webinar.
scenes.cue: Four cards land as you list them. Let them breathe.

scenes.line: Pro costs twenty-nine a month. Free costs nothing.
scenes.cue: Two bars, two prices. Beat between the sentences.

scenes.line: Paste the link. Keep what it ranks highest. Export vertical.
scenes.cue: Three steps, three beats. The longest line in the reel, so do not rush it.

scenes.line: It cuts clips. It doesn't create them.
scenes.cue: The honest ceiling. Calm, no apology.

scenes.line: Comment CLIP and I'll send you the three steps.
scenes.cue: Slowest line in the reel. An offer, not a pitch.

clean_read: You don't need an editor to post clips. The free plan gives you sixty minutes a month. Feed it any podcast, talk or webinar. Pro costs twenty-nine a month. Free costs nothing. Paste the link. Keep what it ranks highest. Export vertical. It cuts clips. It doesn't create them. Comment CLIP and I'll send you the three steps.
notes: Record over the _silent cut. Every line sits on the picture it describes - this was rewritten 2026-08-18 after the first pass mapped VO to the draft beat names instead of the engine's slots.
Never say the tool is unlimited. 60 minutes a month, watermarked, 3-day export window.
CLIP is spoken as the word.
gate: 60 min/mo and $29 Pro are vendor-page figures. Free clips carry a watermark and a 3-day download window - scene F says so on screen, so the voice does not have to repeat it.
